tei:div.tei:p: 319) ༄༅/ zhi khro gnas brgya gsog lugs rgyas pa ltar/ hrī: sngon=

chab/ spos/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs yul nas/ bgegs gtor yan/ las byang che ba'i bstod pa/ dzapra dmigs/ bho dhi/ ru lu/ yig brgya/ mchod bstod/ sde bdun/ brgya klong*/ tshogs skong ba lhag ma yan/ bdag 'jug gnang ba/ gnas 'dren dbus nas/ dbang rdzas rtags yan/ bkra shis brjod/ yang las byang chung ba'i/ rdo rje slob dpon= mchod rlabs nas/ bstod bshags yan/ dngos grub rtsol= lta bu'i dzapra bskul/ bho dhi/ ru lu/ brgya tsam/ mchod bstod/ brgya klong bsdus pa/ tshogs nang skong ba/ bka' gsang rmad byung= lta bu/ lha gam yan tshar gnyis gsum mos/ dbang len/ gnas 'dren bsdus pa'i dbu nas dbang yan/ yang phyin drug khrus nas dbang yan tshar du dgos/ shis brjod/ de ltar nyin la tshar du 'gro yin/ nub mo gnas 'dren rgyas pa'i zas gtad man mthar dbyung*/ smon lam/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ bskul chad brtan man mthar dbyung*/ ༈ 'bring po ltar na/ las byang che ba/ klong bshags 'phros/ dbang len/ gnas 'dren rgyas pa'i dbang yan tshar nas/ rdo rje slob dpon= bsam brjod bral ba'i= nas/ bstod bshags/ dzapra bskul/ bsnyen pa/ stong tshig bar tshar gnyis gsum sogs bsag dbang len nas/ gnas bsdus dbu nas dbang yan/ phyin drug khrus nas dbang yan sogs/ shis brjod/ yang las byang nas bsag tshar rjes ma'i stong tshig rjes/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs skong rgyas pa/ lhag ma 320) yan/ gnas bsdus dbu nas bsags zin nas zas bsngo man rgyas pas mthar byung*/ ༈ bsdus pa ltar na/ hrī:sngon= chab/ spos/ brgyud 'debs/ gang dag 'dir gnas= dkar gtor/ sarba bigh+naṃ= bgegs gtor/ las byang bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ rdo rje slob dpon= mchod rlabs nas bstod bshags yan/ bh+ruṃ bi shwa= dzapra khang dbye/ bsnyen dmigs/ spyi dril bzla/ bum par rang byung= sogs/ bum sgrub/ yig brgya nyer gcig las bum sgrub/ stong tshig sde bdun/ brgya phyag spyi gtsug pad zla'i= klong bshags yan/

rig me dor/ gnang ba nod/ gnas bsdus dbu nas dbang skur rdzogs pa yan/ yang las byang bsnyen bstod yan tshar lnga/ dbang chen gnas bsdus tshar lnga/ yang phyi dro/ las byang tshar bzhi/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs skong ba bcas/ bsgral bstab rjes rig pa'i me tog dor/ gnang ba zhu/ gnas bsdus tshar bzhi zin nas zas gtad/ lam bstan/ me sbar/ bzang spyod/ tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ bskul pa/ chad tho/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhush+pe= chos sku nam mkha'= lta bu'i bstod pa/ nongs bshags/ bkra shis/ na mo: 'khor gsum= dngos grub len/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= gzugs snang thams cad= skad cig stong gsal= rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs brjod pas grub bo/ 321) ༄༅/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba gtong lugs ni/ rtsa gtor skong chog gtor ma rgyas par/ zhi gtor zhe gnyis/ drag gtor nga brgyad/ 'bring po zhi gtor bzhi/ drag gtor drug bsdu na/ zhi gtor gcig la pad+ma'i tshab ril bu zhe gnyis sbyar ba dang*/ drag gtor gcig la mtheb skyung brgyad sbyar ba/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ cha gsum/ tshogs gnyis/ gsol ka gnas 'dren la/ zhi sbyong pad sbubs gsum/ phyed ma la zan kong gsum/ lan chags gsum/ zas bsngo/ gtso las bum pa/ me long*/ byang bu bcas 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ gzhung gsal/ dge'o// 322)
